# telnyx_access_ip_range (Resource)

A CIDR block allowed to reach the Telnyx API and portal for your account. Read from the list of ranges, because the API has no single-range read.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr_block` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `status` (String) An enumeration.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `user_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

terraform import telnyx_access_ip_range.example <id>
